description: This source file defines a sealed class PdfFontDescriptorCache which manages a cache of PdfFontDescriptor objects associated with a PdfDocument. It provides functionality to retrieve or create font descriptors based on OpenType descriptors, used specifically within PDF font handling in the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: PdfFontDescriptorCache
classes.description: A cache for storing PdfFontDescriptor objects for a specific PdfDocument, optimizing font descriptor retrieval and creation.

methods.name: GetOrCreatePdfDescriptorFor
methods.description: Retrieves an existing PdfFontDescriptor from the cache for a given OpenTypeDescriptor key or creates a new one if it does not exist.
